links.comparator_used: Full-text articles versus abstracts as the input for GPT-4-Turbo lay summaries
links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level and human-rated) and human-rated accuracy of lay summaries
links.effect: Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level 7.13 (abstract) vs 7.39 (full text); mean human accuracy 7.09 vs 7.42 out of 10
links.quote: Human-review metrics showed these summaries were of similar readability and accuracy when generated using abstracts versus full text articles, with mean accuracy scores from human review of 7.09 vs 7.42 out of 10 respectively.

links.comparator_used: No comparison with the original unsimplified abstracts or papers; the study evaluated the LLM summaries on their own
links.outcome: Human-rated clarity and accuracy of LLM lay summaries of cancer research, and patient partners' view of their usefulness
links.effect: Summaries rated around 7 out of 10 by 18 volunteers; all patient partners said the summaries would help them decide whether to join research studies
links.tradeoff: Patient partners emphasized the need for summaries to be accurate and reliable; mean accuracy was about 7 out of 10.
links.quote: They were rated at around 7 out of 10 points.

design_hint: reading-level constrained prompting; abstract vs full-text input
